text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One weekend, I'm out and about<n>when I spot
Nakayama heading down<n>an alley. In spite of
myself, I can't<n>help but remember the rumors from
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what they put on the table,<n>but they're
lookin' for her like their<n>life depends on it. Yeesh.
Who knows<n>what'll happen if they find her?
choice_data_list: Hey, Nakayama. What are you up to?
Hey, Nakayama. What are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's just you. I'm not up to<n>much, just a
bit of this and that.
choice_data_list: ...Would you mind if I tagged along?
...Would you mind if I tagged along?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If anything were to happen to my<n>trainee, it's my
job as a trainer to<n>step in and protect her. As she
looks<n>me over, I open my mouth to try and<n>explain
more, when she speaks up<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You've got weird taste too,huh? Suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Owner of Tiny Restaurant
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Nakayama. Offal stew,<n>hot outta the
pot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, "weird taste" meant a<n>hole-in-the-wall
joint hidden down an<n>unassuming alley. There's a
good<n>number of chairs and tables set out,<n>so the
place must be doing fairly well<n>for itself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now this is the good stuff.<n>Man...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks great as always!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Perfect... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that hit the spot. Nothing fills an<n>empty belly
like offal. Oh, also... could I<n>get the beef and tofu
dish and some<n>pork stomach?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We eat our fill and head out, but just<n>as we leave
the alley, we're<n>suddenly called over by... a
policeman?!

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I was right, it was you after all. I've<n>been looking
for you. And... this is<n>your guardian, I presume?

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I know this is sudden, but if possible,<n>could I ask
you to come down to the<n>station with me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. Just get it over with.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Puppy
text_block_list.text: Arf arf! Arf!

text_block_list.name: Puppy's Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, aw, Mugi. You remember her?<n>She saved
you!

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
She found a "stray" puppy, and was<n>caring for her
by the riverbank.<n>Meanwhile, I was trying to get the
lost pup back to her owner, and went<n>to take her.

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text:
I caused a bit of a misunderstanding,<n>so Nakayama
Festa and I got off on<n>the wrong foot, but I'm glad I
could let<n>you know how everything worked out<n>in
the end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You didn't have to keep meposted. And I didn't need to come allthe way here to see the pup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...So I was right after all. The bad<n>rumors about
Nakayama were just<n>misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It falls dark, and we're starting to cut<n>it close with
Nakayama's curfew. I'm<n>just about to suggest
heading back<n>to Tracen, when...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! It's Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now what?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A group of rough-looking high<n>schoolers swarm us
and walk us<n>down to the riverbank, out of sight<n>from
the street.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
I've been lookin' for you, Nakayama.<n>I hear you
cheated my boys in poker,<n>and acted like you beat
them all legit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I did beat 'em legit. They just lost on<n>their own. I
didn't use anything but<n>my head, so shut up and
accept that<n>you got outplayed.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen A
text_block_list.text:
You shut up! Like hell you were<n>playin' fair! No
one'd ever go all in<n>with a hand that bad, not
without<n>knowing what cards we had!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Teen B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Now quit playin' dumb, or<n>we'll make sure
you can never run<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It takes a second to realize that the<n>retort had just
come out of my own<n>mouth.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, you stay outta this. This<n>one's between
them and me.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
That badge... So you're this cheat's<n>trainer, huh? If
you don't mind your<n>own business, you're goin'
down<n>first.
choice_data_list: Fine by me. If you want a fight, I'll take it.
Fine by me. If you want a fight, I'll take it.

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? You're actin' awful<n>confident. You wanna
spend the rest<n>of your life phonin' in training plans
from the hospital? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The one who seems to be in chargeof the group cracks his knucklesmenacingly. I size him up, and ooooh,I do not fancy my chances.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But win or lose, I'm not standing<n>down. I'm a
trainer! I won't let them<n>lay a hand on Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Stepping in front of Nakayama, I put<n>my arms up
and walk over to the guy,<n>stopping right in front of
him.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hang on. You're joking, right?

text_block_list.name: Delinquents' Leader
text_block_list.text:
Tch... The hell is with you two?! This<n>ain't worth it.
C'mon guys, we're<n>outta here! Who knows what
these<n>cheats are up to...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, ahahaha! You didn't bat an<n>eyelash
challenging a whole gang,<n>and now you're shaking
like a baby.<n>Hahahah... so much for your big bluff.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you ever run into guys like that,<n>just brush 'em
off and ig...nore...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. Well, well. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. See? Take a look at yourself.<n>At what you
really are.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still shaking, it takes a second to<n>follow her gaze to
a shop window,<n>where I see my own reflection.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm taken aback by the... the look on<n>my face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now... workin' with you justgot real interesting.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm locked in a daze the whole walk<n>home. When I
finally cross the door,<n>it's like my body runs cold.
I'm hit<n>with a wave of exhaustion, and I flop<n>down
on my bed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I bring my hands up to my face, and<n>just watch as
they shake. The image<n>of myself in that window is
burned<n>into my mind, Nakayama's words<n>echoing in
my ears.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. See? Take a look at yourself.<n>At what you
really are.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Something about her laughter, the<n>knowing look in
her eyes... the look I<n>saw in my own eyes... It all
whirls<n>again and again through my mind.
